_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience; and designing and selling devices'; 'Business model competition': 'We and our competitors continue to devote significant resources to developing and deploying cloud-based strategies and services for consumers and business customers' and 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open-source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'Our cloud and AI strategy requires substantial investments and depends on evolving customer demand, technological developments, competitive dynamics, and regulatory conditions'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which could adversely affect our results of operations' (its own FY2026 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: Microsoft's own FY2026 10-K, under 'Business model competition', says 'We and our competitors continue to devote significant resources to developing and deploying cloud-based strategies and services for consumers and business customers.', and under 'Our cloud and AI strategy requires substantial investments and depends on evolving customer demand, technological developments, competitive dynamics, and regulatory conditions, any of which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.', 'If these costs increase, remain elevated, or fail to decline, or if pricing for AI products and services declines as a result of competition, commoditization, or other market forces, our margins, financial condition, and results of operations could be adversely affected.' It competes with cloud services of its own: 'Continuing to bring to market compelling cloud-based and AI products and services that generate increasing traffic and market share.' The stock trades at 27.5x FY27E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of Microsoft's licensed software specifically.

Live: Microsoft's own FY2026 10-K, under 'Business model competition', says 'AI technology and services are a highly competitive and rapidly evolving market, and new competitors continue to enter the market. Our AI offerings compete with AI products from hyperscalers, open-source offerings, and frontier model providers, some of which are also current or potential partners.' and that some companies compete with it 'developing, making available, or using AI models that are open' ('Some open-source products mimic the features and functionality of our products.') It sells generative AI of its own: 'We are investing in AI across the entire company and infusing AI capabilities into our offerings.' The stock trades at 27.5x FY27E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of Microsoft's software seats or search specifically.

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience; and designing and selling devices'; 'Business model competition': 'We and our competitors continue to devote significant resources to developing and deploying cloud-based strategies and services for consumers and business customers' and 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open-source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'Our cloud and AI strategy requires substantial investments and depends on evolving customer demand, technological developments, competitive dynamics, and regulatory conditions'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which could adversely affect our results of operations' (its own FY2026 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.39x; +31% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.57; conservative 2yr +31%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY17-FY26, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +17.0%/yr (Q1 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +20.7%/yr (FY17-FY26 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +29.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY17-FY26); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2026-09-18) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.39x (24.7% downside to Bear $372 / +63.2% upside to Bull $806) | Adj composite 2.59 vs market 2.02: gap +0.57 [UNDERVALUED] | +31% above the EPP floor $377 (21x FY27E $17.95) | Conservative 2-yr case: +31.2% total (+15.6%/yr) | At 27.5x FY27E the 15% hurdle price $653 sits at or below the BASE case; unearned revenue +12.6% in Q4 FY26, forward revenues +15.7-17.1% (Q1 FY27 revenue guide); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
